title: verbascum virgatum subsp. lusitanicum
intro: Verbascum virgatum subsp. lusitanicum, commonly known as Lusitanian Mullein, is a plant species within the figwort family, native to the Iberian Peninsula. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Lusitanian Mullein include its ability to soothe respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant properties, and its potential to treat skin conditions like acne and eczema. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
